abstract: Covers OpenID Federation for Trust Anchors, Intermediates, Leaves, Trust Mark Issuers and resolvers. The current line is OpenID Federation 1.1, split into Federation 1.1 and Federation for OpenID Connect 1.1, both Final; OpenID Federation 1.0 Final is supported, and the pre-Final drafts (ID4 and earlier) are legacy, with upgrade steps from the draft 49 Document History. The Subordinate Events Endpoint and Extended Subordinate Listing Implementer's Drafts are included at track posture. References are split into versions and upgrades, entity statements, trust chains, metadata policy, trust marks, endpoints and client registration.
